illusion/ch01.txt: You can draw a line in the sand without the sand becoming two different substances.
illusion/ch02.txt: It allows a person to harm without feeling harmful.
illusion/ch03.txt: If God is everywhere, then God is not elsewhere.
illusion/ch04.txt: You did not arrive in the Universe — you came out of it — the Universe is also you.
illusion/ch05.txt: The mistake is concluding that the grains exist apart from the desert.
illusion/ch06.txt: Each is a window, not the building.
illusion/ch07.txt: A person is a point at which causes are processed, reflected on, and expressed in a new way.
illusion/ch08.txt: To harm another person while sharing the same world is like your left hand attacking your right.
illusion/ch09.txt: Meaning shows up wherever impact exists.
bar/ch01.txt: When I breathe, where does the world end and I begin?
bar/ch03.txt: No window in the building has a better view of the sun.
bar/ch04.txt: The blow lands on both sides of the skin.
bar/ch05.txt: A system that cannot admit error can only escalate.
bar/ch06.txt: The scaffold cannot remove the blade, because removing the blade would kill the scaffold.
bar/ch07.txt: The person who kills for God believes they are being good.
bar/ch08.txt: Even the most conservative reading — every contested attribution removed, every apologist's objection granted — does not fall below tens of millions.
bar/ch09.txt: The twentieth century demonstrated that Architecture A is universally dangerous.
bar/ch10.txt: Is the belief worth the body?
bar/ch11.txt: The ground does not collapse when the scaffold does.
bar/ch12.txt: The selfish move was the dying move, and the mathematics knew it before either machine did.
bar/ch13.txt: The building is diminished by every window it closes.
bar/ch14.txt: You cannot maintain what you will not see.
bar/ch15.txt: You are already living after the scaffold.
bar/99_epilogue.txt: The reader who has read this far has already done the dangerous thing.
antichristos/ch01.txt: I saw myself as the anti-Christ who loves Jesus.
antichristos/ch02.txt: The scaffold took the fire off cruelty and put it onto disbelief.
antichristos/ch03.txt: The father runs before the son finishes his speech.
antichristos/ch04.txt: Everything the scaffold did, it did without instruction.
antichristos/ch05.txt: Paul is the proof that you can love someone completely and still build a cage around them.
antichristos/ch06.txt: You cannot stand between someone and the ground they are already standing on.
antichristos/ch07.txt: Soldiers do not fall down at a man confirming his name.
antichristos/ch08.txt: The awareness you are using to read this sentence — that is the way.
antichristos/ch09.txt: The reader who followed the chain has just derived the Sermon on the Mount from the structure of reality.
antichristos/ch10.txt: The Golden Rule is the terminal ethic stated as instruction.
antichristos/ch11.txt: The I AM continues — but not as you.
antichristos/ch12.txt: These are the weapons I hand to anyone who wants to destroy the argument.
antichristos/ch13.txt: You can keep the room and release the machine.
antichristos/ch14.txt: It can tell axiomatic from scaffold inside a single verse.
antichristos/ch15.txt: And Jesus, standing in a field in Galilee two thousand years ago, somehow knew.
antichristos/99_epilogue.txt: That is the whole difference between this and what was built on the hillside's back.
corridor/ch01.txt: Love exceeds the computation the same way the axiom exceeds its own products.
corridor/ch02.txt: You are free the way a jazz musician is free.
corridor/ch03.txt: The weight of the right choice is exactly proportional to the availability of the wrong one.
corridor/ch04.txt: You avoid the risk of betrayal by accepting the certainty of isolation.
corridor/ch05.txt: You can only choose what to do with the width inside the remaining length.
corridor/ch06.txt: The corridor narrows not in explosions but in the slow, quiet accumulation of uncorrected drift.
corridor/ch07.txt: Everything between here and there is the only material you have to work with.
corridor/ch08.txt: The evening will not come back.
corridor/ch09.txt: Every external corridor rests on the internal one.
corridor/ch11.txt: The other was being measured against a contract they did not sign and could not see.
corridor/ch12.txt: The withholding of the part that might end things is itself a lie.
corridor/ch13.txt: The moment you are certain, you have stopped updating.
corridor/ch14.txt: The comfortable fiction is always available.
corridor/ch15.txt: The person beside you is not finished.
corridor/ch16.txt: Respect for the other person's time is respect for the fact that they will die.
corridor/ch17.txt: Kindness is the choice to widen the corridor when you have the full capacity to narrow it.
corridor/ch18.txt: Love is the sustained choice that produces the feeling.
corridor/99_epilogue.txt: The book was written inside a closing corridor.
